title: Arabella in the AI chase scene

It'd be great to find that video
and use Arabella's character to run that chase, to jump over things.
Actually, one second. Ivy, I just realized I need to get milk if you're able to put a little reminder in there.

Anyway, back to the idea. And Arabella runs through that scene. She jumps. She pushes away from people. It's a really cool AI scene, but using Arabella instead of the Chinese guy in the actual video.
